title: AC1024 associative-only DXF-origin replay

scope.sourceProfile: Locally authored AC1024 source graph with one ACDBASSOCNETWORK, one ACDBASSOC2DCONSTRAINTGROUP, one ACDBASSOCGEOMDEPENDENCY and no dynamic-block objects.
scope.operation: Import generated ASCII/Binary DXF, independently prepare exact typed/raw AC1024 associative snapshots, traverse owner/reactor closure, replay OBJECTS, and freshly import output.
scope.claimBoundary: Adapter transport, graph validation, failure/retry and DXF readback only; no associative semantic evaluation, native application acceptance, DWG output or support-claim promotion.

changes: AC1024 DXF associative graph traversal now requires complete associative typed/raw carrier pairs without requiring an unrelated dynamic-block carrier set.
DXF associative replay preparation and output admission are independent of dynamic-block replay, while remaining restricted to same-version AC1024 and complete typed/raw identity.
Successful associative replay publishes its own qualified-record count after staged-body inspection; it no longer depends on dynamic-block replay inspection.
Staged replay diagnostics identify source import/cardinality, typed-model, raw-record, or target-version mismatches.
implementation.failureAndRetry: A late ACDBASSOCNETWORK model mutation after OBJECTS staging is rejected; the pre-existing destination sentinel remains unchanged and qualifiedRecords remains zero. Restoring the source and retrying with the same exporter succeeds.
implementation.readback: ASCII and Binary outputs freshly import with all three typed and raw associative carriers, no dynamic-block objects, unchanged record identities/owners and selected network, constraint-group, geometry-dependency and target-reactor fields.
implementation.fixturePolicy: The graph is authored by the existing runtime test. Temporary DXF files are removed by the selector. No persistent DWG/DXF fixture was added.

focusedSelector.result: PASS for ASCII and Binary. Expected diagnostics from invalid-graph and injected late-mutation refusal controls were emitted.
focusedSelector.fullSuite: NOT RUN; only the owning selector was used.

completedScopeRemovedFromQueue: Associative-only AC1024 DXF-origin replay admission, independent qualification bookkeeping, late-mutation rollback/retry, and ASCII/Binary fresh readback.
remaining: Other source-required P4 bodies, owner edges and dependencies that lack strict output/readback proof.
All independent semantic, native consumer, platform, and other P4-P9 qualification gates.
